lines.intro: A grumpy gull puffs up on the lookout bench. It wants ALL the snacks!
lines.command: How can Fae calm the gull?

soothe.great: Fae hums a gentle sea shanty. The gull's feathers settle down!
soothe.good: Fae hums softly. The gull tilts its head.
soothe.miss: The gull squawks right over Fae's humming.

play.great: Maddie pounces after a floating feather. The gull flaps along, delighted!
play.good: Maddie bats at a feather. The gull peers down at her.
play.miss: Maddie chases her own tail. The gull rolls its eyes.

cast.great: Sue casts her ribbon bobber out over the cliff. The gull swoops after it!
cast.good: Sue's bobber bobs in the wind. The gull's eyes follow it.
cast.miss: Sue's line catches the breeze and tangles. The gull snorts.

juggle.great: Jordan juggles three pinecones. The gull catches one, very proud!
juggle.good: Jordan tosses a pinecone high. The gull eyes it hungrily.
juggle.miss: A pinecone bonks Jordan on the head. The gull squawks with laughter.

lines.snack: Fae shares a whole sandwich. The gull gobbles it and looks a little less grumpy.
lines.burst: The gull flaps a huge gust of feathers and sea spray at Fae!

burstResult.good: Fae dodges most of the spray!
burstResult.miss: Splash! Fae gets a face full of sea spray.

lines.soothed: The gull lets out a long, happy sigh. The fizzy spell blows away on the breeze!
lines.rest: Fae is too windblown to go on. Time for a rest.
lines.run: Fae backs off the lookout. The gull guards the bench.
